scripts.build:test-dependencies: npm run build --workspace nestjs-firebase --workspace nestjs-graphql-relay --workspace nestjs-slack-webhook --workspace nestjs-zendesk
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces && npm run clean:test
scripts.clean:test: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['.test-dist', 'example/.test-dist']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.compile:test: npm run clean:test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p example/tsconfig.test.json && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('dummy.firebase.amin.key.json', 'example/.test-dist/dummy.firebase.amin.key.json')"
scripts.test: npm run rebuild:test-native && npm run build:test-dependencies && npm run compile:test && node --env-file-if-exists=example/.env.test --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=".test-dist/packages/*/src/*.js" --test-coverage-exclude=".test-dist/**/*.spec.js" --test-coverage-exclude=".test-dist/**/*.test.js" ".test-dist/**/*.spec.js" ".test-dist/**/*.test.js" "example/.test-dist/example/**/*-spec.js" "example/.test-dist/example/**/*.spec.js"
